text: Custom orders – Kigurumi Sensei Skip to content Menu Menu About Us How to maintenance Custom orders Custom orders In addition to the inventory in our store, we can make kigurumi masks of your preference by custom order. (commission) Please send a message to our store ( Kigurumi Sensei Store on Etsy) for any questions or inquiries. 【 Current commission status: Closed 】 Scheduled to reopen in October. Check our social media for reopening announcements! Facebook and Twitter for the latest information. Facebook / Twitter / Instagram This process is required for all kigurumi custom orders. Consultation for production of final estimate and payment page requires advance payment of $15. After you pay $15, you will have a discussion with us to determine how much the mask you want to make will cost. Please be sure to send us images and references of the character you want to create. We do not offer design creation. Please be sure to prepare a design drawing of your own. The price is for one character. If you need a quote for more than one character, please purchase more than one. If you actually order the mask, you will receive a $15 discount off the final price. This means that the quote is practically free. Munimuni base $580 + Munimuni base cyclops $680 + Original base $850 + These are the minimum prices and prices will vary depending on the design. All payments must be made in advance. If you have a Klarna account, you can choose to pay in installments at the time of payment. For details↓ https://help.etsy.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055660114-How-to-Use-Klarna-to-Pay-in-Installments?segment=shopping Shipping costs are not included. Around $50 if you live in the US, around $100 if you live outside the US (international shipping). Import taxes may apply when shipping overseas. Masks are only available as half masks or 3/4 full head masks. (We do not offer locking masks or hinged full head masks) The price guarantee for the quoted price is one month, so it is recommended that you request a quote when you are ready to purchase. We take the time to research materials and production methods in order to calculate accurate prices. Thank you for your understanding and support.
